title: C57BL/6 male mice, normal food, 71weeks, rep1
growth_protocol_ch1: C57BL/6 male mice were reared over a period of 71 weeks in a controlled environment, with temperatures consistently maintained between 18 to 22 degrees Celsius.
extract_protocol_ch1: Total RNA was isolated from liver using Direct-Zol™ RNA microprep kit (Zymo research, CA, USA) according to the manufacturer’s protocol. | RNA Libraries for RNA-seq were prepared using NEBNext Poly(A) mRNA magnetic Isolation Module and NEBNext Ultra II Derectional RNA Library Prep Kit for Illumina
data_processing: Raw sequencing data were processed using Illumina bcl2fastq conversion tool to generate FASTQ files | Sequences were aligned to GRCm39 genome to gene expression count using New Tuxedo Protocol's default settings | Gene expression level of Refseq coding genes were quantified using Ballgown tool which inspect the distribution of abundance estimates. | Assembly: GRCm39 | Supplementary files format and content: tab-delimited text file includes raw counts for each Sample | Supplementary files format and content: tab-delimited text files include FPKM values for each Sample
